```yaml
name: Eng Common TSP Client Test

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up .NET Core
      uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v2
      with:
        dotnet-version: '5.0'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: dotnet restore

    - name: Build solution
      run: dotnet build --configuration Release --no-restore

    - name: Run tests
      run: dotnet test --configuration Release --no-build --logger "console;includeCategory=Information"

    - name: Check Python validation
      run: |
        python tools/python-validation-checks/validate.py
        if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
          echo "::error::Python validation checks failed"
          exit 1
        fi
```
